title: attendance.records.correct
description: Correct the clock-in and clock-out of one working day. Every correction keeps a trail with the old values, the new values and the reason. Without `clock_out_at` the day is open again.

record_id.description: Id of the working day to correct.

clock_in_at.description: New clock-in in UTC, exactly as Date.prototype.toISOString() writes it (e.g. 2026-10-06T08:00:00.000Z). Offsets are refused: records are compared and sorted as UTC text.

clock_out_at.description: New clock-out in UTC (toISOString() form), or null to leave the day open. Must be after the clock-in.

reason.description: Why the record is corrected. Mandatory: it is what an inspector reads.
